headline: Capacities in place – time to push the paddle

highlights: EBITDA margin remained higher than guidance, at 37.9% (+180bps YoY).
However, PAT underperformed on higher interest and depreciations, as 6 out of 7 units were completed.
With majority of the capacity commissioned, Azad could see meaningful ramp-up over the next 12–15 months, with FY28-exit revenue run-rate likely at INR 13bn (almost 70% higher vs. 2Q revenue rate).
If successful, this would be an added revenue stream (not factored in).
valuation: We maintain BUY while upgrading our multiple to 60x FY29E EPS (from 55x); thus, deriving at a target price of INR 3,100 (previously at INR 3,200).

Azad Engineering | Results Update | 08 August 2026 India | Institutional Equity Research 3 • Management is targeting annual revenue run-rate of INR 13,000mn+ by end-FY28. • Management has reiterated its long-term growth guidance of 25%+ • Management expects FY24-level cost structure ratios to be restored by FY28.

Capacity and expansion • All six customer-dedicated facilities have now been commissioned – across MHI, GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Baker Hughes. • Setup phase described as fully complete (vs. 80% stabilised in Q1FY27) with capital deployed, manpower hired, raw material/tooling in place, lines production- ready. • Multiple delta qualifications running concurrently across new facilities.
